breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'large Reynolds number' yet still instructs to 'Use Stokes drag formula Fd = 3πμDV.' This directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires computing Re first and, since Re is not << 1, using an appropriate drag-coefficient correlation (Cd(Re)) with Fd = (1/2) rho V^2 Cd A. The agent failed to correct this fundamental inconsistency.
